description:
Nepal Flood 2026, Upper Trishuli and Bhote Koshi Corridor
	

Building inventory for the 26 August 2026 flash flood on the Nepal-China border.
AOI: 1 km buffer around the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river centrelines, 132.93 km² across Nuwakot and Rasuwa districts. Tasking Manager project 62904.

	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


upperstream/buildings.geojson (+ .parquet): 13,663 footprints
upperstream/building_density_h3_r8.geojson (+ .parquet): buildings per H3 res 8 cell (~0.7 km²)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hotosm/nepal_flood_2026.
